criterion.title: Query Embedding with nomic-embed-text
criterion.given: I have a user query string
criterion.then: the system uses nomic-embed-text model (same as documents) AND returns a 1024-dimensional vector AND normalizes the vector for cosine similarity

criterion.title: Vector Search Retrieves Top-K Chunks
criterion.given: I have an embedded query vector
criterion.then: pgvector cosine similarity search retrieves top-K chunks (K=5 default) AND results are filtered by tenant_id AND bot_id (RLS enforcement)

criterion.title: Search Results Include Metadata
criterion.then: each result includes: chunk text content, document name (source), section/page reference (if available), similarity score (0-1 scale), chunk metadata (document_id, chunk_id, position)

criterion.title: Search Performance Under 200ms
criterion.given: I have a typical knowledge base with 1000 chunks
criterion.then: search latency is <200ms (p95) AND pgvector HNSW index enables fast approximate search

criterion.title: HNSW Index Configuration
criterion.given: the chunks table exists with embeddings
criterion.then: index includes tenant_id and bot_id for query filtering AND uses parameters: m=16, ef_construction=64

criterion.title: No Results Handling
criterion.then: empty result set is returned AND no error is thrown AND downstream RAG pipeline can handle gracefully

criterion.title: Short Query Handling
criterion.given: I have a very short query (1-2 words)
criterion.then: the embedding is still meaningful and produces valid search results

criterion.title: Long Query Truncation
criterion.given: I have a very long query (>500 tokens)
criterion.then: the query is truncated before embedding AND search still produces relevant results

criterion.title: Special Characters Handling
criterion.given: I have a query with special characters and non-ASCII text
criterion.then: special characters are handled correctly AND search results are accurate

criterion.title: Deterministic Search Results
criterion.given: I execute the same query twice
criterion.then: identical queries return identical results (deterministic behavior)

artifact.snippet: System retrieves relevant document chunks using semantic vector search with pgvector. Embeddings generated by nomic-embed-text model, stored in PostgreSQL with HNSW indexing for fast approximate search.

backend.package: version: latest (Python client for Ollama API)

constraints.constraint: Search latency must be <200ms (p95) for typical knowledge bases (1000+ chunks)
Embedding latency must be <20ms per query using local Ollama service
RLS enforcement: All searches filtered by tenant_id AND bot_id (no cross-tenant leakage)
Use nomic-embed-text model (same as document processing) for consistent embedding space
HNSW index parameters: m=16, ef_construction=64, ef_search=40 for recall/speed balance
Vector dimensions: 1024 (nomic-embed-text output) - enforce consistency across all embeddings
Empty search results return gracefully (no error) - downstream RAG handles no-context case
HNSW index supports approximate search for large knowledge bases (10K+ chunks)
Retry logic with exponential backoff for Ollama API failures (3 attempts)
Optional fallback to OpenAI Embedding API if Ollama unavailable

interface.name: POST /api/v1/bots/:bot_id/search
interface.signature: POST /api/v1/bots/{bot_id}/search { query: str, k: int, similarity_threshold: float } -> 200 { query: str, results: [...], search_latency_ms: int }
interface.notes: Requires authentication. User must own bot. Returns top-K chunks with similarity scores, document names, sections.

interface.name: EmbeddingService
interface.notes: Integrates with Ollama API for nomic-embed-text. Returns normalized 1024-dim vector. Handles truncation, retries, fallback.

interface.name: VectorSearchService
interface.signature: async search(bot_id, tenant_id, query, k, threshold) -> List[SearchResult]
interface.notes: Executes pgvector cosine similarity search with RLS. Returns chunks with metadata and similarity scores. Handles empty results.

interface.name: Chunk Model with pgvector
interface.notes: Add embedding column with pgvector type. Include cosine_distance and cosine_similarity operations for queries.

tests.standards: Unit tests isolate services with mocked Ollama API and database. Integration tests verify end-to-end search with real embeddings. Performance tests validate <200ms p95 latency. Test frameworks: pytest + FastAPI TestClient (backend). All tests must verify RLS enforcement and similarity score accuracy.
tests.locations: Backend tests: apps/api/tests/ (pytest discovers test_*.py files). Integration tests: apps/api/tests/integration/ (E2E search flow). Performance tests: apps/api/tests/performance/ (latency benchmarks).
